description: GETREE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: (C23 H44 Ce1 Fe1 N4 Na1 O10)n,n(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Fe1 (Fe) has 4 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2 (Fe) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.343-3.800 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 101.75-135.36°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula ([Fe2Ce2Na2O2((CH3)3CCO2)8(N3)2(ap)2]·2CH3CN)∞ (vacuum-dried material analyzed as (6·2H2O)∞).
